open_region: (i) Fermiophobic/WW-dominated H++ with ctau ~0.1-100 mm: no collaboration search targets a same-sign or charged-parent displaced vertex, and no collaboration result is interpreted for H++ in this regime. Displaced-lepton searches without a charge requirement (CMS 2110.04809; ATLAS 2410.16835) have partial acceptance but have not been reinterpreted; the ATLAS DV dilepton search requires opposite charge. (ii) Compressed triplet (Delta M ~1-30 GeV, soft same-sign leptons/ISR): no collaboration search found; phenomenology only (2305.06889, 2603.15882). (iii) Hadronic-tau H++: CMS tau_h channels exist only with 12.9 fb-1 (PAS); ATLAS full Run 2 uses e/mu only; no Run-3 or HL-LHC tau_h projection by a collaboration found.

key_caveats: Displaced regime: existing displaced-lepton searches (no charge requirement) may already constrain part of ctau 1-100 mm for H++->l+l+ or leptonic W; a recast is needed before claiming openness.
Low-mass Yukawa case (m 100-150 GeV) is also near LEP/early LHC same-sign bounds; per 2608.27251 long-lived Yukawa H++ only exists for m<150 GeV.
CMS full Run-2 or Run-3 H++ (tau) analysis could be in preparation (Helsinki thesis suggests activity) - 'not found' is not absence.
Recast 2608.03988 questions ATLAS 2211.07505 4l efficiency; limits may be weaker than published.
Compressed-triplet insensitivity of SUSY soft-lepton searches is a pheno claim (2305.06889 citing 2108.10952), not verified by recast here.
CMS PAS tautau limit value inconsistent between sources (535 vs 396 GeV).
